discovery: Strict preregistered metadata-schema parser rejected the canonical CSV header before emitting support counts or scores.
support: Lean is a case-only field spelling discrepancy. HF355 metadata defines datetime as the image acquisition date/time, matching the canonical header acquisition_date_time. Neither field changes an outcome, eligibility rule, model fit, or primary target.

scientific_protocol: All original independent-validation rules remain unchanged; only explicit source-to-metadata header mapping is added. No biological scores preceded this amendment.
